Date-16/01/2023 Ref. No.- PURCK/2K23/1107 D
Advertisement Notice of Guest Faculty
The applications are invited for appointing Guest Faculty to teach at Panjab University
Rural Centre Kauni, Sri Muktsar Sahib for the Academic Session 2022-23 (Even
Semester) for the following subject.
Sr. No. Subject Date No. of Vacancies Time
1. Last Date to receive
Application from in the office
of P.U. Rural Centre, Kauni
English 03-02-2023 01 03:00 PM
The applicants are required to fill the application form for Assistant Professor available
on Panjab University website (http://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms /20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf) (page 1
to 12). The candidates should send prescribed application form along with supporting
documents and attested copies of all the certificates/documents (Two copies each) and
two passport size photographs upto 03.02.2023 in the office of Panjab University Rural
Centre Kauni.
The above assignment is on lecture basis with an honorarium of Rs. 1000/- per lecture
with an upper limit of Rs. 25000/- per month.
Contact at purckauni@pu.ac.in and 01633-292000 for any enquiry.
Note: - The date and time for walk in interview will be intimated to the eligible candidates.
Minimum Qualification is as per UGC norms.
Sd/-
DIRECTOR PURC Kauni
Sri Muktsar Sahib
